card.name: Length of 21-day treatment cycles
card.fires_on: The word "day" or "days" in "21-day" or "(21 days)" describing the length of a chemotherapy cycle. Weaker on a few other dosing-schedule words like "dosing" in same-day dosing.

modes.label: 21-day cycle
modes.description: The "-day" or " days" right after 21 when naming the length of a cycle in oncology dosing.

modes.description: Occasional timing words in dosing instructions, such as "dosing" in same-day adjustments or "the" before morning.
